notes.title: 40% Off This Week Only
notes.content:
The one and only time we plan on putting this game on sale during our early access period is right now.

[b]For just $3[/b] (or a similar amount in your currency) you can buy a nifty enchanting puzzle game.

I hope you will give it a try. Either way, keep on casting.

On Call Witch
Game Designer and Developer

notes.title: Today's Update: Better graphics, better gameplay.
notes.content:
Behold! An update. The game plays a bit better and looks a lot better, in my humble opinion.

[b]RELEASE NOTES v0.0.7.8 early access:[/b]
[list][*] Graphics update is underway. New block pieces!
[*] Spell buttons always visible during The Quest.
[*] Extra spells removed from The Quest.
[*] New “How To Play” button added to all four modes.
[*] Slight scoring changes to the puzzle modes.
[*] Bonus time awards slightly decreased for Survival.
[*] “X” button added to the main menu, so you can exit without ALT+F4. (ALT+F4 will still work. On a related note: Some people are playing on devices without keyboards! Lesson learned.)
[/list]

If you like today’s update, please leave us a review. It really makes a difference. The first two weeks have been a good start - thanks for helping to spread the word. [b]You are why Grid Magic is Real.[/b]

- Andrea
On Call Witch

notes.title: GRID MAGIC IS REAL.
notes.content:
The spell is cast, the puzzle game is released, and officially [b]Grid Magic is Real.[/b]

If you've purchased the game - thank you very much. If you liked it, please leave a review. Either way, feedback is welcome. Please let me know what you think - it will help to shape the roadmap going forward.

Magic is better when we make it together. Thanks for being a part of this.

- Andrea Davis
On Call Witch
Game Designer and Developer
